devdoc.author: Matter Labs
devdoc.details: Temporary protector of the values of ZKsync. They can approve upgrade changes proposed by the Token Assembly, propose & cancel L2 proposals as well as extend the legal veto period of L1 upgrade proposals through the `ProtocolUpgradeHandler`.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

params._id: The unique identifier of the upgrade proposal.
params._signatures: An array of signatures from the guardians approving the upgrade.
params._signers: An array of signers associated with the signatures.

params._l2Proposal: The L2 governor proposal to be canceled.
params._signatures: An array of signatures from the guardians approving the upgrade.
params._signers: An array of signers associated with the signatures.
params._txRequest: The L1 -> L2 transaction parameters needed to request execution on L2.

checkSignatures(bytes32,address[],bytes[.details: The function to check if the provided signatures meet the threshold requirement. Signatures must be from unique members and are expected in the same order as the members list (sorted order).

params._digest: The hash of the data being signed.
params._signatures: An array of signatures to be validated.
params._signers: An array of signers associated with the signatures.
params._threshold: The minimum number of valid signatures required to pass the check.

constructor.details: Initializes the Guardians contract with predefined members and setup for EIP-712.

params._members: Array of addresses representing the members of the guardians. Expected to be sorted in ascending order without duplicates.
params._protocolUpgradeHandler: The address of the protocol upgrade handler contract, responsible for executing the upgrades.

params._id: The unique identifier of the upgrade proposal.
params._signatures: An array of signatures from the guardians approving the extend.
params._signers: An array of signers associated with the signatures.

returns.proposalId: The unique identifier for the L2 proposal in compatible format with L2 Governors.

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes).details: The function to check if the provided signatures are valid and meet predefined threshold.

params._digest: The hash of the data being signed.
params._signature: An array of signers and signatures to be validated ABI encoded from `address[], bytes[]` to `abi.decode(data,(address[],bytes[]))`.

params._l2Proposal: The L2 governor proposal to be proposed.
params._signatures: An array of signatures from the guardians approving the upgrade.
params._signers: An array of signers associated with the signatures.
params._txRequest: The L1 -> L2 transaction parameters needed to request execution on L2.

APPROVE_UPGRADE_GUARDIANS_THRESHOLD.details: The number of signatures needed to approve the upgrade by guardians.

APPROVE_UPGRADE_GUARDIANS_TYPEHASH.details: EIP-712 TypeHash for protocol upgrades approval by the guardians.

CANCEL_L2_GOVERNOR_PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD.details: The number of signatures needed to cancel the proposal on one of the L2 Governors.

CANCEL_L2_GOVERNOR_PROPOSAL_TYPEHASH.details: EIP-712 TypeHash for canceling the L2 proposals by the guardians.

EXTEND_LEGAL_VETO_PERIOD_TYPEHASH.details: EIP-712 TypeHash for extending the legal veto period by the guardians.

EXTEND_LEGAL_VETO_THRESHOLD.details: The number of signatures needed to extend the legal veto period for the upgrade.

PROPOSE_L2_GOVERNOR_PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD.details: The number of signatures needed to propose the proposal on one of the L2 Governors.

PROPOSE_L2_GOVERNOR_PROPOSAL_TYPEHASH.details: EIP-712 TypeHash for proposing the L2 proposals by the guardians.

ZKSYNC_ERA.details: ZKsync smart contract that used to operate with L2 via asynchronous L2 <-> L1 communication.

nonce.details: Tracks the unique identifier used in the last `cancelL2GovernorProposal`/`proposeL2GovernorProposal` to ensure replay attack protection.

EIP1271_THRESHOLD().notice: The threshold for EIP-1271 signature verification.

PROTOCOL_UPGRADE_HANDLER().notice: Address of the contract, which manages protocol upgrades.

extendLegalVeto(bytes32,address[],bytes[.notice: Extends legal veto period for ZKsync protocol upgrade, by the 2 out of 8 Guardians approvals.

members(uint256).notice: List of addresses authorized as members of the multisig.
